# Theatre Directing @ VTheatre.net

> > A comprehensive resource for theatre directing methodology, covering Stanislavsky, Vakhtangov, and Meyerhold techniques through the stagematrix framework developed by Anatoly.

This site provides educational materials on theatre directing theory and practice, including script analysis, visual composition, mise-en-scene, and production team management. It features resources for directors, students, and theatre practitioners studying classical Russian directing methods and contemporary stagematrix approaches.

## Key Topics

- stagematrix
- mise-en-scene
- theatre-directing
- Stanislavsky method
- Vakhtangov technique
- script-analysis

## Core Directing Theory

- [Directing, Director](https://direct.vtheatre.net/director.html): Core directing theory covering Stanislavsky method and mise-en-scene
- [Vakhtangov: Directing Theatre -- StageMatrix](https://direct.vtheatre.net/vakht.html): Vakhtangov method for play analysis and script interpretation

## Production & Stagecraft

- [Visual Composition at Directing with Anatoly](https://direct.vtheatre.net/compos.html): Visual composition techniques for staging and blocking by Anatoly
- [Director Crew, Stagematrix](https://direct.vtheatre.net/crew.html): Director crew roles and production team structure in stagematrix

## References & Resources

- [References Theatre Directing, Stagematrix](https://direct.vtheatre.net/ref.html): Bibliography and references for theatre directing and stagematrix

## Optional

- [LUL Theatre](https://direct.vtheatre.net/lul.html): LUL theatre directing class and student work in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
